text: dsh-settings-beautify 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的设置界面样式插件。它通过浏览器端 DOM 标记器识别设置面板中的标题、说明、卡片和控件，再用统一样式调整排版、卡片、输入控件、焦点状态与标签。用户可切换启用状态、紧凑或舒适密度及悬停动效偏好，偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage。适合希望统一 DSH 设置页及第三方设置页视觉风格的用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-settings-beautify styles DSH web settings. Its browser tagger marks headings, cards, and controls, then applies consistent typography, spacing, and focus styles. Density and motion preferences are stored in localStorage. Third-party pages can opt in; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 各个设置页面的字体和卡片看起来统一。
DSH 设置里的按钮、输入框和标签样式不一致，能统一整理吗？
How can I apply consistent styling across DSH settings pages?
dsh-settings-beautify 的功能「统一设置页样式」：客户端自动识别设置面板的标题、说明、卡片、行和控件并应用统一的字体、间距、边框与焦点样式；第三方页面可通过标记属性选择加入。
dsh-settings-beautify 的功能「调整密度与动效」：用户可更新启用状态、显示密度及悬停动效偏好；设置写入 localStorage 并同步到打开的对话框。

dsh-settings-beautify README · What it does：DSH's settings are composed from many plugins, and each page historically
speaks a slightly different typography and surface language — page titles in
16/18/22px, explanations in 12/13/14px, cards with 8/10/12px radii, controls
with their own heights and focus styles.

**dsh-settings-beautify** normalizes every settings page onto a single design
language:

dsh-settings-beautify README · What it does：- **Architecture**: every page is built from the same three-part hierarchy —
  **标题 / Title** → **解释 / Explanation** → **内容 / Content** (通用 General
  settings keeps its preference-row form, which is the same hierarchy in a
  compact variant).
- **Typography**: one size for every page title, one for every explanation,
  one for every item title and item description — regardless of which plugin
  contributed the page.
- **Surfaces**: consistent card radius/border/background, consistent rows,
  controls, focus rings, tabs, chips and scrollbars, all driven by DSH's own
  `--dsw-*` tokens, so **light / dark / system** themes keep working.
- **Motion**: subtle, tasteful hover micro-motion that respects
  `prefers-reduced-motion` and can be turned off.
- **Extensible**: any page — including pages contributed by other plugins,
  such as archived-conversation lists — opts into the same language with one
  attribute (`data-dshb-scan`), and the DOM normalizer handles the rest.
- **Headless**: the plugin adds nothing to the settings nav rail — no
  settings page of its own. Preferences are opt-in and live in
  `localStorage`.

dsh-settings-beautify README · What it does：It works without touching DSH's source: the plugin observes the settings
panel, marks each structural role with a stable `data-dshb-*` attribute (the
built-in class names are build-hashed and can't be relied on), and a scoped
stylesheet applies the language on top.

dsh-settings-beautify README · What is covered：| Surface | Built in |
| --- | --- |
| Settings shell (nav rail, header, close, scrollbars) | ✅ |
| 通用 General — every preference row (language, appearance, font size, Enter behavior, agent presets, permissions, …) | ✅ |
| 模型 Models | ✅ |
| 智能体预设 Agent presets | ✅ |
| 内置插件 Built-in plugins (search, scope groups, catalog) | ✅ |
| Agent 预设 Agent presets (group headings, preset cards, tags) | ✅ |
| Any third-party page that adds `data-dshb-scan` to its root (e.g. an archived-conversations page) | ✅ |

dsh-settings-beautify README · From the plugin market：`dsh-settings-beautify` follows the DSH community-market package contract
(`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` manifest), so it can be installed from the
market or with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-settings-beautify
```

dsh-settings-beautify README · Manual install (development)：```sh
pnpm add dsh-settings-beautify        # into the profile's package set

dsh-settings-beautify README · name: dsh-settings-beautify：```

After install, restart DSH Desktop (or reload the web window). The design
language is applied automatically — nothing is added to the settings nav
rail.

dsh-settings-beautify README · Preferences (headless)：The plugin has no settings page of its own. Preferences are read from the
browser's `localStorage` under `dsh-settings-beautify:prefs`:

| Key | Values | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | Apply the language or restore DSH's original look. |
| `density` | `compact` / `default` / `comfortable` | Row and list spacing. |
| `motion` | `true` / `false` | Card hover micro-motion. `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |

dsh-settings-beautify README · Preferences (headless)：Defaults: `{"enabled": true, "density": "default", "motion": true}`. To tune
them, open the browser console and run:

```js
window.DSHB.setPrefs({ density: "compact" })   // or { enabled: false }, { motion: false }
```

No host files or settings namespaces are touched.

dsh-settings-beautify README · The design language：The full specification — tokens, hierarchy, spacing/radius/motion scale, and
the `data-dshb-*` attribute contract — lives in
[docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md). A condensed version:

dsh-settings-beautify README · The design language：| Role | Font | Color |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Page title (页面标题) | 18px / 600 / 26px | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` |
| Page explanation (页面解释) | 13px / 400 / 20px | `--dsw-alias-label-tertiary` |
| Group title (组标题) | 14px / 600 / 22px | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` |
| Item title (条目标题) | 14px / 500 / 22px | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` |
| Item description (条目解释) | 13px / 400 / 20px | `--dsw-alias-label-tertiary` |
| Body (正文) | 14px / 400 / 22px | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` |
| Caption (辅助文字) | 12px / 400 / 18px | `--dsw-alias-label-tertiary` |

dsh-settings-beautify README · The design language：Cards: 12px radius · `--dsw-alias-border-l2` · `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3` (elevated over the panel).
Controls: 8px radius, 36px min-height, brand focus ring. The title → caption
gap is a uniform 4px everywhere the language applies (`--dshb-gap-title-desc`,
matching DSH's row convention). Radii are tokenized (`--dshb-*`) so a future
version can offer alternate palettes.

dsh-settings-beautify README · Contributing pages from other plugins：The DOM normalizer auto-tags the built-in pages. For **your** plugin's page,
either:

1. Add `data-dshb-scan` to the page root (a third-party section hosted
   inside the settings dialog works the same way) — the normalizer then
   applies the same heading/prose/card/row/control rules generically,
   including the uniform 4px title → caption gap; or
2. Use the attributes directly (`data-dshb-page-title`,
   `data-dshb-item-title`, `data-dshb-card`, …) for full control.
dsh-settings-beautify README · Contributing pages from other plugins：See the [extensibility contract](docs/DESIGN.md#the-data-dshb-attribute-contract).

dsh-settings-beautify README · Design notes：The plugin is intentionally **headless**: it only restyles the settings
surface. If you would rather have a visible control page, that is a small
follow-up change — open an issue and it can be added behind a preference.

dsh-settings-beautify README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check             # syntax checks
pnpm test              # fixture-driven jsdom tests (135 assertions)
pnpm sync-styles       # regenerate lib/styles/settings.css from lib/client.js

dsh-settings-beautify README · Development：The tests do not hand-write a stand-in DOM. `test/fixtures/<version>.json` is
captured from a running DSH Desktop — the settings panel's markup *and* the
stylesheets the host injects — and `test/cascade.mjs` recomputes the cascade in
jsdom (specificity, inheritance, `var()` substitution, the shorthands the tagger
reads). Every heuristic is therefore exercised against the computed styles the
real build produces, not against inline styles that would silently stop
matching it.

dsh-settings-beautify README · Development：After a DSH upgrade: `pnpm capture-fixtures`, run `pnpm test`, and fix what the
new surface broke. The fixture is committed, so a regression is reproducible
offline without a browser.

dsh-settings-beautify README · Compatibility：- DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 (DSH Desktop, bundled web UI). **Currently adapted through
  0.1.7-rc.2** against a captured fixture of that build.
- What 0.1.7-rc.2 changed underneath the plugin: the settings shell kept its
  contract (`nav` / `content` / `header` / `options` /
  `[data-slot="settings.section"]`), but every page below it was re-laid out —
  cards moved from 12px to 20px radius, the plugin-market page is gone
  (replaced by a searchable built-in plugin inventory), the DSH Desktop
  settings page no longer contributes a settings section, the header gained a
  second button, and tag/chip labels became a shared `_tag_*` primitive.
  0.3.0 removed the selectors that no longer exist and taught the tagger the
  new shapes (a preference row is now detected by its divider + padding, cards
  by their border box, chip labels by their pill radius).

  plugin import ca

dsh-settings-beautify README · Security：No network requests, no host APIs, no file access, no remote code. Preferences
live in `localStorage`. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
